comment.comment:
Here is why i’m bullish on $GTA6 for a new higher ATH because of pure history.

GTA V dropped September 17, 2013.

GTA Online launched exactly 14 days later on October 1, 2013.

That two-week gap turned a massive single-player game into a decade-long cultural and financial monster.

GTA VI single-player launched November 19, 2026.

If Rockstar follows the same history, Online lands on December 3, 2026.

That’s perfect timing:

•  Peak holiday season — people have free time and want to play with friends

•  Most players will already be done (or nearly done) with the story mode by then

•  The social/FOMO energy of grinding Online with the boys during Christmas break will be insane

Extra goodies that make this even stronger:

•  GTA VI is already a historic monster (24M+ copies and $2.3B+ in the first days, 99 Metacritic)

•  Online is historically where the real long-term money and cultural domination happens

•  This token already has a proven community + built-in TTWO rewards

Previous ATH was solid.

This next leg has the exact historical blueprint, perfect holiday timing, and a much bigger cultural moment than 2013.

New higher ATH is the expectation to my belief.

$GTA6 is looking like the next best alt coin.
